Title: Improvements to blob upload blade in Azure portal

Body.Content: We've released a new version of the blob upload experience in the Azure portal. It includes several enhancements, such as the ability to upload directly to a specific folder, view inline all the uploads in progress for the specified account, and auto-detect and upload VHDs as page blobs. It also includes a few bug fixes.
